source.name: Tour du Rwanda - Partners (Platinum)
source.note: The partners block on the race's own site lists Visit Rwanda (visitrwanda.com) as the sole Platinum partner, with a dedicated 'Visit Rwanda - Discover the Land of a Thousand Hills' section.

note: Top-tier (Platinum) partner of the 2026 Tour du Rwanda; Visit Rwanda is the Rwanda Development Board's official tourism brand (government money). Fee not published.
